gen-dafont-starborn-gf-numans: Wide pockets of blank space between letters mark Starborn, with a heavy lowercase band through every line. But Numans takes the modern, clean job: rope-swollen lowercase, wide tracking, and an s with ends hanging far from the spine.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-onest: Starborn feels ethereal, its lowercase a dark band through every line. Onest, with short ascenders over big bowls and a gentle uniform line thickness, keeps paragraphs approachable from the first to the last.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-oxygen: Letters held far apart, with a heavy lowercase band running through each line, give Starborn its dreamy look. Oxygen then reads clean and contemporary, its curves staying open and its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-preahvihear: Dreamy first, Starborn spaces its letters wide and darkens each line's lowercase. Starborn handles the mood; Preahvihear handles the reading, with open letter mouths and a lofty x-height that feels modern.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-prompt: Starborn drifts along each line with ethereal, widely spaced letters and a heavy lowercase texture running right through. Prompt grounds it below with oversized lowercase and clearly open apertures.

gen-dafont-starborn-gf-questrial: Huge stretches of blank space between letters define Starborn, plus a heavy lowercase band. But Questrial handles the practical side, its single-weight strokes cut flat and its r, n and m arches matching their stems.
